premises.text: Security teams cannot easily answer where PII/files live or who accesses them company-wide, while traditional DLP pits security against productivity
premises.evidence_span: a security team has no easy way to answer any of the questions I ask, especially company-wide. Existing cyber solutions make humans responsible for security actions, when in reality, security actions often get in the way of getting a job done

premises.text: Traditional DLP deployments take weeks to over a year and rely on error-prone hand-jammed rules
premises.evidence_span: When it comes to deploying a traditional data loss prevention tool, 98% of organizations take more than a few weeks, with almost half of them taking four months to over a year

premises.text: Identity-tied per-file encryption secures unused files while exposing only the file in active use
premises.evidence_span: If you have 1,000 files on your computer and you're only using one, then you expose that one while 999 files are secured by Phalanx

premises.text: Overlays everyday document actions in existing environments with identity-based automation deployable in under a day and zero weekly maintenance
premises.evidence_span: Phalanx is an identity-based solution that leverages automation. And that means we're deployable in less than a day and requires zero weekly maintenance

premises.text: Digital map/API visibility of every file across workspaces enables geo and stale-file risk controls
premises.evidence_span: Phalanx provides a digital map of every file across every existing workspace. SysOs can finally see who's accessing what, where, and how across their workspaces

premises.text: Dual GTM: per-seat enterprise sales plus channel partners for SMB DLP
premises.evidence_span: we have a dual-pronged go-to-market strategy where we focus on mid- to large-scale enterprise by doing per-seat requirements, so we're scalable with the needs of those security teams, and we can also deploy out to SMBs via the channel

value.text: Cybersecurity that lets humans stay productive while reducing data-loss exposure
value.evidence_span: We have cybersecurity that lets humans be human
